claim_ceiling: Prepared strategy and evaluation design coherence only; no experiment launch readiness, trials, empirical effectiveness, or worldwide originality claim.
limits: No scored or unscored experimental trial was executed.
Case packets, reference archives, final prompts, and runtime settings remain launch prerequisites.
Review covers five declared preparation artifacts, not dispatch execution tooling or other files.
Concrete operators do not imply independent output mechanism families or efficacy.
The finite design is not powered for a population-level claim or global originality assessment.
acceptance_reason: All four preparation findings were repaired and independently rechecked; prepared design only, not experiment launch readiness.

findings.finding: The generator-facing template requests exact frozen baseline IDs although reference archives are evaluator-only.
findings.repair: Separate generator-visible case/incumbent evidence references from evaluator-added archive matches; label post-Distill lineage as later-stage data.
findings.resolution: Generator references are supplied incumbent/case evidence IDs; archive matches are evaluator-only. post_distill_lineage is null during generation and an explicit distill_stage supplies the later completion policy.

findings.finding: Anonymous presentation is specified but randomized execution and blind-packet order are not explicit.
findings.repair: Require randomized condition execution and judge presentation order, preserving the recorded seed or schedule.
findings.resolution: PROTOCOL.md and protocol.json specify randomized within-block condition execution and independently shuffled blind packets with recorded order seeds, without claiming model randomness is controllable.

findings.finding: Maximum totals cover scored runs but omit the mandated format preflight and unspecified retries.
findings.repair: Label scored-plan allocations; separately count one three-call preflight and bound retries, with zero a valid default.
findings.resolution: README and PROTOCOL label 104 scored runs. One separately budgeted preflight yields 105 total run units, 315 generation calls, and 252000 output-token allocation including preflight. Zero retries is the default; any change requires an explicit frozen additional bound.

findings.finding: The N10 provenance attributes a particular sentence preference to the user without a recorded selection.
findings.repair: Describe the sentence as an illustration from the prior exchange without attributing a specific user preference.
findings.resolution: N10 now says its parent addition was prompted by an illustrative sentence in the prior exchange; no particular user preference is claimed.
